summary: Verified PREVIEW environment (https://insightbridge-web.preview.emergentagent.com) correctly serves the NEW index.html with the two iframe replacements. All 6 review assertions PASS against the preview. The legacy POLARIS tools.html iframe, OTA True Cost Calculator widget on home, and the three 'Live AI Model' cards (ORION/POLARIS/NOVA Launch buttons) in #page-ai-model are confirmed REMOVED. The new dashboard iframe (src=https://intelligence.insightbridge.global/dashboard) is correctly present in both #page-home and #page-ai-model. This confirms the issue is on the user's PRODUCTION deploy pipeline (Emergent deploy snapshot stale), not in the code.
expected_console_warnings: CSP frame-ancestors violation when loading https://intelligence.insightbridge.global/dashboard inside the preview domain — EXPECTED per review request (sister site whitelists only insightbridge.global / www.insightbridge.global). Iframe element IS present in DOM with correct src; only the rendered content is blocked. Not a bug.
action_items: No code changes required — preview HTML is correct.

User-facing issue is on Emergent production deploy pipeline: production at https://insightbridge.global is serving an OLDER snapshot (0 dashboard iframe refs, 18 otach- IDs still present per user report). Main agent should advise user to re-trigger production deploy / verify deploy snapshot matches latest commit.
critical_code_review_comments: index.html is 4296 lines — single-file monolith. Long-term: consider splitting page sections into separate HTML files or templating, but out of scope for this task.

Both replacement iframes correctly use loading=lazy and referrerpolicy=no-referrer-when-downgrade, and the section provides an 'Open full screen ↗' anchor as a graceful fallback when CSP blocks the embed (good UX given the known CSP constraint).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Static HTML site at /app/frontend/site/index.html served by Node static server. Hash-based SPA navigation (#page-home, #page-ai-model, etc.). Preview URL: https://insightbridge-web.preview.emergentagent.com. The dashboard iframe will be visually blank in preview due to sister-site CSP frame-ancestors restricting to insightbridge.global only — do NOT flag the blank iframe as a bug; only verify the iframe element exists in the DOM with correct src. The /app/frontend/src folder is dead CRA boilerplate, not used by the live site.
rca of the issue: User report: production still shows old version after deploy. RCA via curl + Playwright on preview: PREVIEW correctly has 4 dashboard iframe refs and 0 legacy 'otach-' IDs, matching latest /app/frontend/site/index.html. Therefore the code is correct and the preview pipeline is working. The discrepancy is on the production deploy pipeline — the deploy snapshot is older than the last commit. Mitigation: user must re-trigger the production deploy from Emergent UI and confirm the new snapshot is published; possibly also bust any CDN/edge cache.
